name: Belter
description: A power-ballad singer in her forties with a muscular, low, braced arcade build and commanding performance energy. Physically fit: strong torso, hips and thighs, low centre of gravity, planted weight; never narrow, dainty or elongated. Her recognition cue is that her wavy auburn hair mass is visibly wider than her shoulders — a large shoulder-clearing mass of thick wavy auburn hair with a high crown and wide side volume, no hat or headwear. She wears a structured crimson performance jacket with angular lapels over a dark fitted top, high-waisted blue mom jeans, a crimson waist accent, and chunky dark ankle boots. She holds one wireless handheld microphone upright in her character-right hand; no cord, no stand. Her ready stance has flexed knees, torso braced over a low centre, feet planted, and the free hand compact and relaxed. Palette, as base/shadow/highlight per material: crimson #C01723 / #7A0D17 / #F0444E; blue denim #4B576F / #2F374A / #8B98B1; skin #B96B4F / #794333 / #DB9372; hair #593029 / #2D1815 / #8A4A3F; microphone #6F747C / #34383E / #B5BAC0; eye white #F3E8D8; eye dark #251713; lip #8E2633; tooth highlight #F4E9D7. Never draw: a hair mass equal to or narrower than the shoulders; slim upright fashion-pose proportions; a youth-coded or elderly caricature; the microphone in the character-left hand; a microphone cord, stand or duplicate microphone; a gown or skirt silhouette; logos, text or real brands.

animations.dance: Grounded power-ballad dance loop: shift through two wide side steps, let the auburn hair and jacket follow. The microphone in the character-right hand does not need to point at the face, and the character-right hand and arm are free to move.
animations.sing: Planted power-ballad vocal loop: brace through the legs, bring the microphone in the character-right hand toward the mouth for a sustained phrase, use one compact free-hand emphasis, then settle back into her ready stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.
animations.flinch: Brief room-sound surprise: shoulders and wide hair lift, torso draws back slightly, then she regains her broad composed stance. No opponent, strike, or physical contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: lower into a compact braced stance, keep the microphone upright in the character-right hand, shield the torso with the free arm, then hold a stable grounded finish. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: step in with low confident weight, square the crimson jacket toward the room, lift the microphone once, then land in her broad performance-ready stance.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: plant both boots, lift the free hand and chin in a proud acknowledgement, let the hair settle, then hold a commanding balanced pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance exhaustion: the low braced posture softens, knees fold safely, and she settles into a supported low final hold. Do not imply impact, injury, or an opponent.
